subject: Align contract window with Q4 launch + proposed volume growth plan
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Nolan <sara@olivelabs.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Align contract window with Q4 launch + proposed volume growth plan

Hi Sara —

Congrats again on the product roadmap hit for Q4 — excited to see Olive Labs go live. I wanted to open a short thread to align the contract timing with your launch and put a recommended structure on the table so you have clear runway for the traffic spike. Key asks below: 

- Can you confirm the target contract start date (you mentioned early Oct on our call)?
- Would Olive prefer a calendar-year renewal cadence or a co-term that matches existing vendor contracts?
- Do you want a 1yr vs 3yr commitment? we can offer stepped usage buckets that grow over time.

Attached are two files: Redwood-proposal-Q4-Align-v2.pdf (summary) and volume-forecast-OLV-2028.xlsx (our forecast assumptions). High level proposal: a 36-month agreement with tiered commit bands that ramp in Q1 and Q3 of year 2 to match adoption, plus an auto-renew clause with 90-day opt-out for the customer. We recommend a nominal multi-year discount (8% year 1 effective, 12% year 2, 15% year 3) tied to committed token volumes.

If you want, Ben and I can send a redline-friendly term sheet or jump on a 30-minute call with procurement to walk through PO timing and DSAR requirements.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148
Redwood Inference — Inference that scales

---
Attachment stubs: Redwood-proposal-Q4-Align-v2.pdf (1.2 MB, PDF), volume-forecast-OLV-2028.xlsx (120 KB, XLSX)
From: Sara Nolan <sara@olivelabs.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@olivelabs.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Align contract window with Q4 launch + proposed volume growth plan

Camila —

Thanks for the proposal and for mapping this to our launch. Quick answers:
- Target start date: Oct 3, 2027 (that's the go-live for our pilot customers).
- Procurement preference: calendar-year is cleaner for finance, but we can consider a co-term if the math works.
- Term length: our CFO prefers predictability — leaning toward 3 years but needs clarity on mid-term true-ups and the ramp schedule.

Procurement here (procurement@olivelabs.com) needs a line-item pricing table (monthly/quarterly billing), T&Cs, and a sample invoice cadence. Also, please include confirmation of data residency and audit log retention (SOC2 requirements).

Can we get a breakdown by month for the first 9 months (Oct ’27–Jun ’28) showing committed vs expected overage exposure? That will feed into our internal capex planning.

Copying Will Turner from legal on any contract redlines.

Best,
Sara Nolan
Head of Product Ops, Olive Labs
Phone: (312) 555-0199

Subject: Re: Align contract window with Q4 launch + proposed volume growth plan

Camila / Sara —

Thanks for the context. I pulled a quick model and attached a one-page pricing summary (inline here) to make the options concrete. Main options: 

Option A (Calendar-year co-term simplicity)
- 36 month term, invoice annually in advance
- Tiered commit bands: 0–250M tokens, 250–750M, 750M+
- Effective discounts: Year1 6%, Year2 10%, Year3 14%
- True-ups quarterly with capped overage at 110% of committed band for first year

Option B (Launch-aligned start + ramp)
- Start Oct 3, 2027; 3-year ramp: 100% baseline for Q4 ’27 (pilot), 150% band after Q1 ’28, 220% after Q3 ’28
- Monthly billing; quarterly true-ups; ability to add burst capacity at a pre-agreed unit rate
- Auto-renew with 90-day opt-out; early termination protection for customer if growth stalls (prorated credits)

Recommendation: go with Option B but include a 6–8 week performance review post-launch to confirm ramp assumptions. I put provisional list pricing next to each band in the attached spreadsheet.

Also please note: SOC2 and audit log retention are covered under our Private deployment controls — happy to surface the relevant pages or sign an addendum.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0222

Quick note from legal: we are fine with the ramp mechanics conceptually but need the following before internal sign-off:
1) A clause that limits the auto-renew increase to no more than 8% year-over-year unless mutually agreed in writing.
2) A clear mid-term true-up process with a 30-day notice window before applying any billing change.
3) A named Redwood contact for SOC2 evidence requests (SLA for responding to audit requests).

We will be on the 30-minute sync on Friday if that still works; procurement will bring our PO template.
